apiVersion: cilium.io/v2
kind: CiliumNetworkPolicy
metadata:
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
  name: churn-renewal-forecast-allow-dns
  namespace: churn-renewal-forecast
spec:
  egress:
  - toEndpoints:
    - matchLabels:
        k8s-app: kube-dns
        k8s:io.kubernetes.pod.namespace: kube-system
    toPorts:
    - ports:
      - port: "53"
        protocol: UDP
      rules:
        dns:
        - matchPattern: '*'
  endpointSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
---
apiVersion: cilium.io/v2
kind: CiliumNetworkPolicy
metadata:
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
  name: churn-renewal-forecast-allow-external
  namespace: churn-renewal-forecast
spec:
  egress:
  - toFQDNs:
    - matchName: clerk.com
    - matchPattern: '*.clerk.com'
    - matchName: api.frontapp.com
    - matchName: api.productboard.com
    - matchName: slack.com
    - matchPattern: '*.slack.com'
    toPorts:
    - ports:
      - port: "443"
        protocol: TCP
  endpointSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
---
apiVersion: cilium.io/v2
kind: CiliumNetworkPolicy
metadata:
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
  name: churn-renewal-forecast-allow-rds
  namespace: churn-renewal-forecast
spec:
  egress:
  - toCIDR:
    - 0.0.0.0/0
    toPorts:
    - ports:
      - port: "5432"
        protocol: TCP
  endpointSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: churn-renewal-forecast
